provenance: GitHub run, job and artifact metadata independently identify the same release source commit. The report tests that source through real handlers and TLS; it does not assert a released binary version.
qrEvidence: The passing Go test decodes the real Admin PNG and compares its payload with the active public pairing URL; the gateway job log records this after the browser checks.

boundaries.realFlow: Browser configures local Admin, opens its public remote link, pairs through HTTPS gateway and outbound host tunnel, sends CSRF-protected PLAY/STOP and receives authoritative SSE state.
boundaries.nativePlayback: Deterministic fake playback backend; no speakers or stage display tested by this check.
boundaries.wakeLock: Actual secure-context UI calls navigator.wakeLock.request, but the browser grant/release object is mocked; device screen-lock prevention is not verified.
boundaries.TLS: Local httptest TLS certificate; browser ignores its certificate error and host uses the test trust store. Public DNS and production certificate trust are not tested here.
